title: The Canon EOS R8 is great for mirrorless camera newbies and is now $428 off in this deal from Best Buy
summary: The Canon EOS R8 packs a 24MP sensor and great astro capability in a compact body. Best Buy is currently offering it for $1,220, which is $28 cheaper than Amazon's Prime Day price.
contentText:
You don't need the latest mirrorless camera to start your photography journey, there is too much functionality for a beginner on them and tend to be very expensive. The Canon EOS R8 is a great camera for someone new to photography, with a 24MP sensor, great high ISO handling for astro and dual-pixel autofocusing. Best Buy is currently selling the model for $28 cheaper than Amazon during their Prime Big Deal Days event with a total saving up to $428.

You can buy the Canon EOS R8, on sale right for $1,220 on Best Buy.

The Canon EOS R8 is compatible with all Canon RF lenses. Jason Parnell-Brookes The build on the Canon EOS R8 is sturdy enough whilst staying light weight. Jason Parnell-Brookes The Canon EOS R8 can handle some of the bigger RF lenses too, without seeming unbalanced. Jason Parnell-Brookes The Canon EOS R8 has a fully articulated LCD screen which makes it a breeze for capturing photographs from difficult angles. Jason Parnell-Brookes The back panel also features buttons that are placed in the right spots for easy use. Jason Parnell-Brookes The dials on top of the Canon EOS R8 allow for easy manipulation of exposure controls and is intuitive enough for beginners and enthusiasts. Jason Parnell-Brookes The Canon EOS R8 is a great beginner full-frame camera that packs a lot of functionality into such a cheap model. We thought the autofocus was great at tracking a range of subjects, using it to capture Venus in the night sky. On top of sharp dual-pixel autofocus, the R8 also has great high ISO handling and is one of the lightest Canon full-frame mirrorless cameras.

This is a great buy for someone looking to get into photography and even astrophotography because it offers strong overall performance within a relatively lightweight and cheap build. The button placement is great for beginners and allows new users to start straight away before moving up to more advanced shooting.

This deal from Best Buy is the lowest price we have seen on this model since January 2025, offering $428 off the retail price on Amazon and offering an extra $28 off the current Amazon price . This huge discount also gives you more spare cash to spend on some nice glass and get one of the best lenses for astrophotography.

Key features: 24.2MP full-frame sensor, DIGIC X image processor, 4K UHD 60p video recording, Dual Pixel CMOS AF II autofocus, ISO range 100-102,400 (expandable to 204,800), 40FPS burst shooting, vari-angle touchscreen LCD.

Product launched: April 2023

Price history: This camera usually retails between $1,499 and $1,349. This price from Best Buy is the cheapest the camera has been since January 2025.

Price comparison: Best Buy : $1,220 | Walmart: $1499 | Amazon: $1,248

Reviews consensus: We gave the Canon EOS R8 four and a half stars for its slim body, great high ISO noise handling and Dual Pixel CMOS AF II autofocusing. We think it is a great budget option for beginners who want to start shooting astrophotography as well as general photography.
